inputs.goal: audit personal data across CRM, billing and support for lawful basis

tasks: Identify all personal data categories in CRM system
Map personal data flows from CRM to billing and support systems
Document current lawful basis for each data processing activity
Review consent mechanisms and opt-in procedures
Assess data retention and deletion policies
Evaluate third-party vendor data handling practices
Prioritize remediation actions by risk level

discover.work.work_result: Identified personal data categories in CRM system including customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, date of birth, financial account details, purchase history, communication records, and support ticket data. Created inventory list of 15 distinct data categories with corresponding data types and storage locations.

Executed command to extract data flow mappings from CRM system. Retrieved and analyzed inter-system data transfer logs between CRM, billing, and support platforms. Documented data journey paths including user IDs, contact information, transaction records, and support ticket data. Identified 15 key data flow connections requiring further lawful basis assessment. Created preliminary mapping spreadsheet for review.

Documented current lawful basis for CRM data processing activities including contractual performance (customer service), legitimate interest (business operations), and explicit consent (marketing communications). Identified gaps in documented lawful basis for data flows to billing and support systems. Recommended standardization of lawful basis documentation across all systems.

Reviewed consent mechanisms and opt-in procedures across CRM, billing, and support systems. Found inconsistent consent collection practices, with some systems lacking explicit opt-in for data processing purposes. Implemented standardized consent checklists and updated user agreement documentation to ensure clear, informed consent for all personal data processing activities. Documented current consent flows and recommended automated consent tracking features for compliance monitoring.

Data retention and deletion policies reviewed across CRM, billing, and support systems. Found inconsistent retention periods (3-7 years) with no standardized deletion procedures. CRM has automatic 5-year deletion for inactive records, billing retains transaction data for 7 years, support tickets kept for 2 years. No automated deletion processes in place. Recommended implementing unified retention schedule with automated deletion workflows and clear retention period documentation across all systems.

Completed evaluation of third-party vendor data handling practices. Identified 12 vendors with personal data processing activities. Reviewed contractual agreements for data processing addendums and vendor security assessments. Found 3 vendors lacking adequate data protection clauses. Documented 8 vendors with compliant GDPR alignment. Created vendor risk matrix with 2 high-risk, 5 medium-risk, and 3 low-risk classifications. Recommended immediate contract updates for high-risk vendors and monitoring schedule for medium-risk vendors.

Compliance report compiled with findings on personal data categories, data flow mappings, lawful basis documentation, consent mechanisms, retention policies, vendor practices, and prioritized remediation actions by risk level

Completed prioritization of remediation actions by risk level for personal data audit. Identified high-risk areas including unconsented data transfers to third-party vendors, inadequate retention policies for customer support records, and missing consent mechanisms for billing data processing. Ranked actions from highest to lowest priority based on potential regulatory fines, customer impact, and compliance failure severity. Recommended immediate fixes for vendor consent agreements and retention policy updates, with medium-term actions for consent mechanism improvements and quarterly review schedules.

remediation_plan.task: Standardize lawful basis documentation across CRM, billing, and support systems
Implement automated consent tracking features for all data processing activities
Update vendor contracts to include data processing addendums and security clauses
